SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
REPORT

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
File No.
& S. L. REGISTRY
S. B. D. 3062
Section A Station,
9 / 1 32
Date January 9 - 1932）

Subject (in full) ........................................................ Isack (Icek) Warszawner.

Made by D.S. Tcheremshansky. .................... Forwarded by DBku a.i.

With reference to the attached letter of January 6,
1931 from the Netherlands Consulate General regarding Isack
(Icek) Warszawner, his identity and record as known to the
Municipal Office are as follows:-

Isack (Icek) Warszawner is a Polish Jew, 67 years of
age, and a native of Warsaw, Poland. His wife, two sons and
two daughters are still residing in that country.

He arrived in Harbin from Warsaw during 1915, and since
that time has been engaged as a commercial broker on a small
scale. About 8 years ago he visited Hongkong in connection
with some business transaction and resided there for about one
month, after which he returned to Harbin. In 1926 he left
Harbin and went to Hankow where he resided until 1929.

He claims to be well known to Mr. M. Belchenko, former
Russian Consul in Hankow, who is at present acting as Portuguese Consul in
that city. Warszawner has visited Shanghai on several occasions.
He arrived here from Harbin about three months ago and is
planning to visit Sourabaya, Java, Netherlands East India, in
order to purchase a quantity of cheap alcohol from certain
Chinese merchants for the purpose of manufacturing Vodka and
other liquors.

He claims to be a friend of one Livin, a Netherland
subject, whom he formerly knew in Hankow about three years ago,
and who is believed to be employed as the manager of a leather
factory in Sourabaya.

Warszawner is at present residing at 534 Dixwell Road
with a friend and fellow countryman named William Katz, merchant,
an American citizen of Polish Jewish extraction.

Warszawner has a quantity of goods stored at Chinese

日期 1932年1月9日）

事由（全称）........................................................ 伊萨克（Icek）·瓦尔沙夫纳（Warszawner）。

由 警探 Tcheremshansky 撰写。.................... 由 DBku 代呈。

兹就随附的1931年1月6日荷兰总领事馆关于伊萨克（Icek）·瓦尔沙夫纳（Warszawner）的来信，其在工部局档案中已知的身份及履历如下：-

伊萨克（Icek）·瓦尔沙夫纳系波兰犹太人，现年67岁，原籍波兰华沙。其妻子、两个儿子和两个女儿仍居住在该国。

他于1915年间从华沙抵达哈尔滨，此后一直从事小规模商业经纪业务。约8年前，他因某些商务交易前往香港，并在那里居住了约一个月，随后返回哈尔滨。1926年，他离开哈尔滨前往汉口，并在那里居住至1929年。

他声称与前任俄国驻汉口领事 M. Belchenko 先生相识，后者目前担任该市葡萄牙领事。瓦尔沙夫纳曾多次访问上海。他约三个月前从哈尔滨抵达此地，并计划前往荷属东印度爪哇岛的泗水（Sourabaya），目的是从某些中国商人处购买一批廉价酒精，用于制造伏特加和其他酒类。

他声称是利文（Livin）的朋友，利文系荷兰籍人士，他约三年前在汉口与其相识，据信目前在泗水一家皮革厂担任经理。

瓦尔沙夫纳目前借住在狄思威路（Dixwell Road）534号，与其同住者为其朋友兼同乡威廉·卡茨（William Katz），商人，系具有波兰犹太血统的美国公民。

瓦尔沙夫纳有一批货物存放在中国

CONSULAAT-GENERAAL DER NEDERLANDEN
VOOR MIDDEN-CHINA.
TEL. AD. HOLLANDIA.

No. 28 .

SHANGHAI, 6 Januari 1931 .

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE & S. C. REGISTRY S. B. D. 3068 6. 1. 31）

（左侧手写批注：No 12009 in room 327 6/1 32. W.P.）
（左侧手写批注：* See D. 1766.）

Sir,

I have the honour to inform you that Isaac (Icek) Warszawer, born in the province of Warsaw in 1865, bearer of passport C.No. 075966, issued by the Polish Delegate at Harbin on October 7th 1931 wishes to proceed to the Netherlands East Indies in order to buy alcohol which he says is used in Shanghai for making vodka and other cheap alcoholic beverages. Mr.Warszawer, who arrived in this city from Harbin about 3 months ago, is at present staying at 634 Dixwell Road in the house of a certain William Katz.* He states to have been in Shanghai once before, about 2 years ago.

I should feel grateful if you could let me know whether the Police is aware of anything against this person as far as morals or politics are concerned.

I have the honour to be,

Sir,

Your obedient servant,

T. [签名]
Vice-Consul,
for Consul-General.

R.C.Aiers, Esquire,
Deputy Commissioner of Police,
Crime & Special Branches,
SHANGHAI.

（右侧手写批注：$2, For comment please. [签名] O.S. Tcheremshanoff 6/1: 30. DBR. 7/1）

（底部手写批注：File re W.Katz attached. [签名] 6/1.）

电报挂号：HOLLANDIA。

第28号。

上海，1931年1月6日。

（印章：上海公共租界工部局警务处 & S. C. 登记科 S. B. D. 3068 1931年1月6日）

（左侧手写批注：1932年1月6日 327室 第12009号。W.P.）
（左侧手写批注：* 参见 D. 1766。）

先生：

谨此通知阁下，艾萨克（Isaac，亦作 Icek）·瓦尔沙韦尔（Warszawer），1865年生于华沙省，持有1931年10月7日由波兰驻哈尔滨代表签发的 C.No. 075966 号护照，拟前往荷属东印度购买酒精，据称该酒精在上海用于制造伏特加及其他廉价酒精饮料。瓦尔沙韦尔先生约三个月前从哈尔滨抵达本市，目前居住在狄思威路634号一位名为威廉·卡茨（William Katz）*的人士家中。他声称曾于约两年前到过上海一次。

如蒙告知警务处是否掌握此人有关道德或政治方面的任何不良记录，不胜感激。

此致
敬礼

T. [签名]
副领事，
代总领事。

R.C. Aiers 先生，
警务处副总监，
刑事及特务处，
上海。

（右侧手写批注：$2，请予评论。[签名] O.S. Tcheremshanoff 1930年1月6日：DBR. 1月7日）
*(注：原文年份写为30，结合上下文应为31或32之笔误，此处照实译出)*

（底部手写批注：附关于 W. Katz 的档案。[签名] 1月6日。）
